mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS ( LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD, NICKNAME, EMAIL, FAVORITE_TEAM_ID, ROLE_CODE, POINT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{favoriteTeamId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, NVL(#{roleCode, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 1), NVL(#{point, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 100), SYSTIMESTAMP )
INSERT INTO USER_PREDICTS ( USER_ID, PREDICT_WIN, PREDICT_TOTAL, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, 0, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT u.USER_ID, u.LOGIN_ID, u.PASSWORD, u.NICKNAME, u.EMAIL, u.FAVORITE_TEAM_ID, u.ROLE_CODE, u.POINT, u.CREATED_AT, u.UPDATED_AT, r.ROLE_NAME FROM USERS u LEFT JOIN USER_ROLES r ON u.ROLE_CODE = r.ROLE_CODE WHERE u.LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}

SELECT u.USER_ID, u.LOGIN_ID, u.PASSWORD, u.NICKNAME, u.EMAIL, u.FAVORITE_TEAM_ID, u.ROLE_CODE, u.POINT, u.CREATED_AT, u.UPDATED_AT, r.ROLE_NAME FROM USERS u LEFT JOIN USER_ROLES r ON u.ROLE_CODE = r.ROLE_CODE WHERE u.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET NICKNAME = #{nickname}, EMAIL = #{email}, FAVORITE_TEAM_ID = #{favoriteTeamId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE USERS SET PASSWORD = #{newPassword}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM AI_MATCHES WHERE HOME_TEAM_ID IN (SELECT CUSTOM_TEAM_ID FROM CUSTOM_TEAMS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) OR AWAY_TEAM_ID IN (SELECT CUSTOM_TEAM_ID FROM CUSTOM_TEAMS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId})
DELETE FROM CUSTOM_SQUADS WHERE CUSTOM_TEAM_ID IN (SELECT CUSTOM_TEAM_ID FROM CUSTOM_TEAMS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET LOGIN_ID = SUBSTR('wd_' || USER_ID || '_' || LOGIN_ID, 1, 50), NICKNAME = '(탈퇴회원#' || USER_ID || ')', EMAIL = SUBSTR('wd_' || USER_ID || '_' || EMAIL, 1, 100), PASSWORD = '*WITHDRAWN*', ROLE_CODE = 7, POINT = 0, FAVORITE_TEAM_ID = NULL, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.POST_ID, p.USER_ID, u.NICKNAME, p.TEAM_ID, COALESCE(t.TEAM_NAME_KOR, t.TEAM_NAME) AS TEAM_NAME, p.CATEGORY_ID, c.CATEGORY_TYPE, p.TITLE, p.VIEW_COUNT, p.LIKE_COUNT, p.IS_BLIND, p.IS_DELETED, p.CREATED_AT, p.UPDATED_AT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENTS cm WHERE cm.POST_ID = p.POST_ID AND cm.IS_DELETED = 'N' ) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM POSTS p JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = p.USER_ID JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CATEGORY_ID = p.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN TEAMS t ON t.TEAM_ID = p.TEAM_ID WHERE p.USER_ID = #{userId} AND p.IS_DELETED = 'N' ORDER BY p.CREATED_AT DESC, p.POST_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POSTS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IS_DELETED = 'N'

SELECT c.COMMENT_ID, c.POST_ID, c.USER_ID, u.NICKNAME, c.P_COMMENT_ID, c.CONTENT, c.IS_BLIND, c.IS_DELETED, c.CREATED_AT, c.UPDATED_AT, p.TITLE AS POST_TITLE, cat.CATEGORY_TYPE FROM COMMENTS c JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = c.USER_ID JOIN POSTS p ON p.POST_ID = c.POST_ID JOIN CATEGORY cat ON cat.CATEGORY_ID = p.CATEGORY_ID WHERE c.USER_ID = #{userId} AND c.IS_DELETED = 'N' ORDER BY c.CREATED_AT DESC, c.COMMENT_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENTS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IS_DELETED = 'N'

SELECT p.POST_ID, p.USER_ID, author.NICKNAME, p.TEAM_ID, COALESCE(t.TEAM_NAME_KOR, t.TEAM_NAME) AS TEAM_NAME, p.CATEGORY_ID, c.CATEGORY_TYPE, p.TITLE, p.VIEW_COUNT, p.LIKE_COUNT, p.IS_BLIND, p.IS_DELETED, p.CREATED_AT, p.UPDATED_AT, TO_CHAR(pl.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS LIKED_AT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENTS cm WHERE cm.POST_ID = p.POST_ID AND cm.IS_DELETED = 'N' ) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM POST_LIKES pl JOIN POSTS p ON p.POST_ID = pl.POST_ID JOIN USERS author ON author.USER_ID = p.USER_ID JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CATEGORY_ID = p.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN TEAMS t ON t.TEAM_ID = p.TEAM_ID WHERE pl.USER_ID = #{userId} AND p.IS_DELETED = 'N' ORDER BY pl.CREATED_AT DESC, p.POST_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POST_LIKES pl JOIN POSTS p ON p.POST_ID = pl.POST_ID WHERE pl.USER_ID = #{userId} AND p.IS_DELETED = 'N'
